Creating a BlockConnector functionally places a Block within a View. If a Category relationship is specified as well, the Block will also be placed within that Category, and the row_index or y_scale attributes will apply to the presentation of the Block within that Category.

Block and the View (and optionally the Category, if the BlockConnector has
a Category relationship).

In the future, we will begin requiring all views (new or existing) to
belong to a parent block, as part of the plan-block re-architecture work.

As of now, if you don't provide a `parent_block` relationship, this
endpoint will automatically create a parent block and associate it with
the new view resource. This parent block will inherit permission from the
workspace, so that access can still be controlled from the view as it
has been.
